name: debug_getRawTransaction_latest

name: debug_getRawTransaction_not_found
description: Nonexistent transaction hash (boundary case for not-found responses)

name: debug_traceBlockByHash_latest
description: Trace the latest block by hash using the default structLog tracer

name: debug_traceBlockByHash_callTracer
description: Trace the latest block by hash using callTracer

name: debug_traceBlock_block1_rlp
description: Trace devnet block 1 using its runtime-fetched raw RLP

name: debug_traceBlock_block1_callTracer
description: Trace block 1 using runtime-fetched RLP and callTracer

name: eth_getStorageValues_l1block
description: Read multiple storage slots across addresses (a reth extension also implemented by geth). Fix {{latest_block_number}} to avoid comparing different latest blocks; L1Block storage changes each block.

name: debug_intermediateRoots_latest
description: Intermediate state roots; reth can compute these only for recent blocks because older state is pruned. Use latest_block_hash; a newly produced block can still cause an occasional empty reth result.

name: debug_printBlock_stub_diff
description: Request a block dump using a numeric block number.

name: eth_config_geth_crash_diff
description: Query chain configuration and compare the returned result or RPC error.

name: admin_peers_empty
description: Peer list: devnet execution clients have P2P discovery disabled, so both should return [].

name: debug_freeOSMemory
description: Force GC to return memory; both endpoints return null (a harmless operational method).

name: admin_nodeInfo_structdiff
description: Node-local identity values may differ; protocol and configuration fields remain strictly compared.
